Automated upkeep of shedding is something no seasoned pet owner would turn down. While the humble lint roller is still the most reliable tool for furniture and black clothes, the best robot vacuums for pet hair can keep your carpets, rugs, tile, and hardwood floors barefoot-ready on a daily basis.

In homes with multiple pets and a perennial layer of fur on the floor, it's valid to wonder whether any robot vacuums actually work well on pet hair. I know it's possible from personal experience — I test new top robot vacuums at home every month, and my cats hold nothing back when preparing the testing grounds. While many basic robovacs flop, I've also witnessed wicked pet hair pickup that aces my post-vacuum lint roller test. So, let me put you on: Here are my recommendations for the best robot vacuum for pet hair.

Though most of the conversation around pet hair pickup will involve how well that robot vacuum performs on carpet, pets don't stop shedding when they cross over to a hardwood or tiled floor. If your home has a pretty even split of both types of flooring, you should eye one of the best robot vacuum and mop combos for pet hair on hard floors. Strong suction power alone isn't always guaranteed to pull up every tiny strand of fur (especially fur that has blown into the corners of the room), and fine dust like pet dander and kitty litter is stubborn to be sucked up as well. In that case, a wet mopping pad using pressure to wipe is much less likely to leave finer debris behind.

Thorough pet hair pickup is rooted in suction power, of course, but brush roll design plays a major role in how well a robot vacuum can pull pet hair out of soft flooring — and how often all that fur gets tangled. You'll want to look for at least 20,000 Pa of suction power for homes with multiple pets, though 30,000 Pa or more would be optimal. The brush roll's material should alternate between rubber or silicone fins and bristles, and ideally break in the middle as a method of preventing wrapping.

Read my full review of the Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete.

The Dreame X60 Ultra Max Complete is a beast of a robot vacuum for homes with multiple pets who shed a lot. Between market-leading suction power and pressurized spinning mopping pads that scrub closely in corners, this would be the most reliable robot vac in homes with plush carpet, lots of floor type changes, and the expectation of literal wall-to-wall cleaning.

The Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete misses out on the crown for "strongest suction power in a robot vacuum" by a hair if you compare its 35,000 Pa to the Roborock Saros 20 and Saros 20 Sonic's 36,000 on paper. But after testing all three at home, I'm confident that that small difference doesn't matter — the X60 Max Ultra Complete still has the best pet hair pickup I've seen, and is the more reliable robot vacuum across the board.

I've put that groundbreaking number to the test on a variety of rug piles at home, and the X60 Max Ultra Complete delivered consistently. Hair from my two tortoiseshell cats camouflages on patterned rugs, so a lint roller test is one straightforward way to double-check a robot vacuum's pet hair pickup. The sticky paper revealed just one or two cat hairs left over on any patch of my tufted living room rug. The X60 also had a perfect pickup rate on my thickest rug, where I mushed clumps of fur from the cat tree down into the fluffy fibers. The noise level is much less of a jump scare than you'd expect for max power mode.

Though I've dubbed it the carpet expert, the X60 Max Ultra Complete's detailed mopping would play a major role in keeping hard floors in your kitchen and bathroom pet hair dander-free. It has double rotating pads, including one hinged pad that swivels out to scrub in 90-degree angles and along wall edges. I've consistently found that this design provides the most meticulous upkeep of those balls of fur that inevitably blow into the corners of my apartment. Detergent automatically dispenses into the clean water tank every time, and Dreame includes two: a regular sanitizing solution and a pet odor solution.

Read my initial review of the Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow.

The Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow is a heavy-duty roller mop robot vacuum that provides thorough pet hair pickup on hardwood and tile floors. It's also a strong performer on large liquid splatters or thick dried-on stains, making it a great overall choice for multi-pet households that are prone to spills or pet waste on the floor.

The Curv 2 Flow's impeccable small obstacle avoidance is also the least likely to run over pet toys scattered on the floor — a key feature for busy folks who don't always have time to tidy up beforehand.

Though I've tested other roller mop robot vacuums with stronger suction, the Curv 2 Flow is the best bang for your buck out of all of them. It regularly goes on sale for less than $800, making it a great choice for budget shoppers who don't want to near the $1,000 mark.

Shedding is hardly strictly a carpet issue — pet hair still accumulates on hard floors, and I've really been enjoying the Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow's sturdy mopping on my hardwood kitchen floor and tile bathroom floor.

The Curv 2 Flow's large paint roller-style mop is great at wiping up minuscule physical debris that tends to stick to hard floors, like ultra-fine hairs, dander, and dusty paw prints by the litter box. All the proof I need comes from the lasers on my Dyson PencilVac, which highlight any and all specks that I wouldn't be able to see with a casual glance — and the Curv 2 Flow leaves high-traffic areas spotless. While I still think that flexible spinning pads (like the Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete's) are slightly more precise in corners, Roborock has nailed roller mop edge mopping in a way other roller mops haven't yet.

Roller mops also take a more absorbent, more hygienic approach than a flat mop pad or dual rotating mops, which comes into play for pet-related cleaning past hair pickup. The Curv 2 Flow has excelled at sopping up large liquid spills on my hardwood kitchen floor, including small chunks of wet pet food. Instead of streaking the splatter across the floor as it continues to mop, the Aqua10 Ultra Roller mop rinses itself in real time — a tidbit I found comforting when sending the Qrevo Curv 2 Flow to mop up runny cat puke.

Past cleaning performance, this Roborock is just a solid robot vacuum for homes with pets in general. Its small obstacle avoidance might just be the most accurate I've ever tried — I've had no run-ins with cords, pet food bowls, cat toys, or (fake) pet waste. The livestream pet camera is always appreciated, too.

Read our review of the 3i G10+.

The 3i G10+ is a genius space-saving hack for pet owners who live in apartments — its ability to "self-empty" (compress debris) without a self-emptying dock means it can be stored under furniture. With small obstacle avoidance, a livestream pet camera, and market-leading suction power for its price range, the G10+ is also the most robust robot vacuum that a budget shopper will find.

This niche robot vacuum from 3i is easily the most powerful robot vacuum under $500 that I've ever come across. Its 18,500 Pa of suction power runs circles around other budget robot vacuums and rivals the suction power of several flagship vacuums that are double (or even triple) its price. This'll boost the volume of pet hair that's sucked up, which will all get compressed inside the vacuum body instead of emptying into a larger self-emptying dock. This takes care of dustbin duty for you for at least two months at a time.

The dust compression feature is definitely unique, but the 3i G10+'s navigational IQ is what impressed me the most about this cheap robot vacuum. Its initial mapping run of my apartment was highly accurate, down to deciphering between beds, credenzas, and even toilets. It even recognized each spot where there's a rug.

The presence of small obstacle avoidance is also impressive at such a practical price point. Pet owners who are concerned about run-ins with pet waste won't want to skip this technology — the G10+ successfully dodged my pet waste dupe (brown sugar) as well as an extension cord and socks. Did I mention the livestream pet camera? You almost never see that feature for less than $1,000 otherwise.

The Roomba Max 715 has emerged as the strongest Roomba to date, offering quadruple the suction power of the budget-friendly Roomba 105. That shakes out to 30,000 Pa of suction power, which cleans circles around the previous most powerful Roomba's 13,000 Pa.

But the suction power alone isn't the only reason why the Roomba Max 715 is the best Roomba for pet hair: iRobot revived its awesome dual rubber brush roll system. These lie parallel to each other and spin in opposite directions, excelling at pinching pet hair that's embedded into carpet. iRobot ditched this brush roll system for a little bit, so I'm psyched to see the return of this design after experiencing it with the Roomba Combo 10 Max.

While it may seem like a downgrade to some, many pet owners actually prefer their robot vacuum to not mop at all — it's sometimes easier not to fuss with tufts of fur sticking to the mopping pads or getting stuck in the tray. There is a mopping version of this model: The Roomba Max 775 Combo.

How we tested

As a senior shopping reporter, I have been testing popular robot vacuums for Mashable in the various apartments I've lived in since 2019 — most recently, a three-bedroom apartment where three people and two cats reside.

Over the course of at least four weeks, each robot vacuum is put through a series of standardized tests that I’ve laid out to exemplify all factors of trusting a robot vacuum in your home on a daily basis. In addition to overall bang for your buck, those tests cover four main pillars of robot vacuum competence:

Cleaning abilities

Each vacuum tackles various spills, debris, levels of pet hair, and floor types. I also tested hybrid vacuum and mop combo models on various stains and spills.

Navigation

I keep tabs on navigational accuracy when it comes to smart mapping my home, finding specific rooms and zones, and identifying small obstacles using LiDAR or cameras.

User friendliness

Your new robot vacuum should be a polite houseguest. I make sure each vacuum isn't too loud, an eyesore, or generally a pain to use.

Maintenance

Many robot vacuums automate their own dust bin emptying, mopping pad washing, and more — the more self-sufficient they are, the better.

任何经验丰富的宠物主人都不会拒绝自动脱毛维护。 虽然不起眼的滚筒仍然是清理家具和黑色衣服最可靠的工具，但最好的宠物毛发机器人真空吸尘器可以让您的地毯、地毯、瓷砖和硬木地板每天都保持赤脚状态。

在有多只宠物且地板上常年有一层毛皮的家庭中，有理由怀疑机器人吸尘器是否真的能很好地处理宠物毛发。 从个人经验来看，我知道这是可能的——我每个月都会在家测试新的顶级机器人吸尘器，我的猫在准备测试场地时会毫不犹豫。 虽然许多基本的机器人吸尘器都失败了，但我也亲眼目睹了邪恶的宠物毛发拾取功能，它在我的真空后棉绒滚筒测试中表现出色。 那么，让我来告诉你：以下是我对宠物毛发最好的机器人真空吸尘器的建议。

尽管大多数关于宠物毛发拾取的讨论都会涉及机器人真空吸尘器在地毯上的表现如何，但当宠物穿过硬木或瓷砖地板时，它们不会停止脱落。 如果您的家中两种地板的分布相当均匀，您应该关注最好的机器人真空吸尘器和拖把组合之一，用于硬地板上的宠物毛发。 仅靠强大的吸力并不总是能保证吸起每一缕细小的毛皮（尤其是被吹到房间角落的毛皮），而且像宠物皮屑和猫砂这样的细小灰尘也很难被吸走。 在这种情况下，使用压力擦拭的湿拖布垫不太可能留下更细的碎片。

当然，彻底的宠物毛发拾取取决于吸力，但刷辊设计在机器人真空吸尘器如何将宠物毛发从柔软的地板上吸走以及所有毛发缠结的频率方面发挥着重要作用。 对于多只宠物的家庭，您需要至少 20,000 Pa 的吸力，不过 30,000 Pa 或更高是最佳选择。 刷辊的材料应在橡胶或硅胶翅片和刷毛之间交替，并且最好在中间断裂，作为防止缠绕的方法。

阅读我对 Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete 的完整评论。

Dreame X60 Ultra Max Complete 是一款野兽级扫地机器人，适用于多只宠物且掉毛较多的家庭。 凭借市场领先的吸力和可在角落里进行紧密擦洗的加压旋转拖地垫，这将是拥有毛绒地毯、地板类型变化较多以及真正需要进行全面清洁的家庭中最可靠的机器人吸尘器。

如果将 Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete 的纸面吸力 35,000 Pa 与 Roborock Saros 20 和 Saros 20 Sonic 的 36,000 Pa 进行比较，它就与“扫地机器人中最强吸力”桂冠相差甚远。 但在家里测试了这三款产品后，我相信这种微小的差异并不重要——X60 Max Ultra Complete 仍然拥有我所见过的最好的宠物毛发拾取器，并且是全面更可靠的机器人真空吸尘器。

我在家中的各种地毯堆上测试了这个突破性的数字，X60 Max Ultra Complete 的表现始终如一。 我的两只玳瑁猫的毛发会伪装在有图案的地毯上，因此滚筒测试是仔细检查机器人真空吸尘器宠物毛发拾取能力的一种直接方法。 粘纸上只露出我客厅簇绒地毯上残留的一两根猫毛。 X60 在我最厚的地毯上也具有完美的拾取率，我将猫树上的毛皮团团压入蓬松的纤维中。 噪音水平远低于您在最大功率模式下的预期。

虽然我称其为地毯专家，但 X60 Max Ultra Complete 的细致拖地功能将在保持厨房和浴室硬地板上无宠物毛发皮屑方面发挥重要作用。 它具有双旋转垫，其中一个铰接垫可以旋转出以 90 度角并沿着墙壁边缘擦洗。 我一直发现这种设计为那些不可避免地被吹到我公寓角落的毛球提供了最细致的维护。 清洁剂每次都会自动分配到净水箱中，Dreame 包括两种：常规消毒液和宠物除臭液。

请阅读我对 Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow 的初步评论。

Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow 是一款重型滚筒拖把机器人真空吸尘器，可在硬木和瓷砖地板上彻底拾取宠物毛发。 它在处理大量液体飞溅或厚厚的干污渍方面也表现出色，对于容易在地板上溢出或宠物粪便的多宠物家庭来说，它是一个很好的整体选择。

Curv 2 Flow 无可挑剔的小避障功能也最不可能碾压散落在地板上的宠物玩具，这对于那些总是没有时间事先清理的忙碌人士来说是一个关键功能。

虽然我测试过其他吸力更强的滚轴拖地机器人真空吸尘器，但 Curv 2 Flow 是其中最物超所值的。 它的售价通常低于 800 美元，对于预算有限、不想接近 1,000 美元的购物者来说是一个不错的选择。

严格来说，脱落并不是一个地毯问题——宠物毛发仍然积聚在硬地板上，我真的很喜欢 Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow 在我的硬木厨房地板和瓷砖浴室地板上的强劲拖地功能。

Curv 2 Flow 的大型油漆滚筒式拖把非常适合擦拭容易粘在硬地板上的微小物理碎片，例如超细毛发、皮屑和垃圾箱旁布满灰尘的爪印。 我需要的所有证据都来自我的戴森 PencilVac 上的激光，它可以突出显示我随意一瞥无法看到的所有斑点，而 Curv 2 Flow 可以使人流量大的区域一尘不染。 虽然我仍然认为灵活的旋转垫（如 Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete 的）在角落处稍微更精确，但 Roborock 已经以其他滚筒拖把尚未达到的方式固定了滚筒拖把边缘拖地。

与平拖把垫或双旋转拖把相比，滚筒拖把还采用了更具吸水性、更卫生的方法，可用于除毛发之外的与宠物相关的清洁。 Curv 2 Flow 擅长吸收硬木厨房地板上的大量液体溢出物，包括小块湿宠物食品。 Aqua10 Ultra Roller 拖把不会在继续拖地时将飞溅物划过地板，而是会实时进行自我冲洗——当我发送 Qrevo Curv 2 Flow 来拖干净猫的呕吐物时，我发现这一点令人欣慰。

过去的清洁性能，这款 Roborock 只是一款适合一般有宠物的家庭的坚固机器人真空吸尘器。 它的小避障功能可能是我尝试过的最准确的——我没有遇到过电线、宠物食品碗、猫玩具或（假）宠物粪便的情况。 直播宠物相机也总是受到赞赏。

请阅读我们对 3i G10+ 的评论。

对于住在公寓里的宠物主人来说，3i G10+ 是一个节省空间的天才工具——它能够“自动清空”（压缩碎片），无需自动清空底座，这意味着它可以存放在家具下面。 G10+ 具有小型避障功能、直播宠物摄像头以及同价位市场领先的吸力，也是预算有限的购物者所能找到的最强大的扫地机器人。

这款来自 3i 的小众机器人真空吸尘器无疑是我见过的 500 美元以下最强大的机器人真空吸尘器。 其 18,500 Pa 的吸力足以媲美其他廉价机器人吸尘器，并且可与几款价格是其两倍（甚至三倍）的旗舰吸尘器的吸力相媲美。 这将增加被吸走的宠物毛发的体积，这些毛发将全部被压缩在真空体内，而不是排空到更大的自排空底座中。 这一次可以为您承担至少两个月的垃圾箱职责。

灰尘压缩功能绝对是独一无二的，但 3i G10+ 的导航智商是这款廉价扫地机器人给我印象最深的地方。 它对我公寓的最初测绘非常准确，甚至可以辨认床、书柜甚至厕所之间的情况。 它甚至能识别出每个有地毯的地方。

在如此实用的价位上，小避障功能的存在也令人印象深刻。 担心与宠物粪便发生冲突的宠物主人不会想跳过这项技术——G10+成功地避开了我的宠物粪便欺骗物（红糖）以及延长线和袜子。 我有没有提到直播宠物相机？ 否则，您几乎永远不会以低于 1,000 美元的价格看到该功能。

Roomba Max 715 已成为迄今为止最强大的 Roomba，其吸力是经济型 Roomba 105 的四倍。 其吸力可达 30,000 Pa，可清洁之前最强大 Roomba 13,000 Pa 周围的区域。

大多数情况下，不会。 互联网上的普遍共识和我的经验来看，机器人吸尘器和宠物可以和谐相处。

然而，虽然没有人“希望”他们的机器人吸尘器声音很大，但对于有易受惊吓的宠物的家庭来说，噪音水平应该是一个更重要的考虑因素。 自动排空底座发出的 10 秒轰鸣声可能会非常刺耳——Roombas 的自动排空声音是我听过的最响亮的，我可以看到这吓坏了听力敏感的宠物。

截至 2026 年初，最强大的机器人真空吸尘器的吸力为 35,000 Pa，其次是其他一些在 20,000 Pa 至 30,000 Pa 范围内的高端型号。 如果您并不是真正关注昂贵的高端型号，那么 10,000 Pa 至 15,000 Pa 之间的更经济实惠的吸力仍然可以非常有效地去除光。 任何吸力为 8,000 Pa 或更低的机器人真空吸尘器可能会带来更多的挫败感，而不是有帮助。

我们如何测试

作为一名资深购物记者，自 2019 年以来，我一直在我住过的各种公寓中测试流行的 Mashable 扫地机器人——最近的是一套三居室公寓，住着三个人和两只猫。

在至少四个星期的时间里，每个扫地机器人都经过了一系列标准化测试，我列出了这些测试，以举例说明每天信任家中扫地机器人的所有因素。 除了整体性价比之外，这些测试还涵盖了机器人真空吸尘器能力的四个主要支柱：

清洁能力

每个真空吸尘器都可以处理各种溢出物、碎片、宠物毛发的水平和地板类型。 我还测试了混合真空和拖把组合模型对各种污渍和溢出物的影响。

导航

在智能绘制我的家地图、查找特定房间和区域以及使用激光雷达或摄像头识别小障碍物时，我会密切关注导航的准确性。

用户友好性

你的新机器人吸尘器应该是一位有礼貌的房客。 我确保每个真空吸尘器的声音不会太大，影响美观，或者通常使用起来会很痛苦。

维护

许多机器人真空吸尘器可以自动清空垃圾箱、清洗拖把垫等等——它们越自给自足越好。
